property_summary: Under any admissible call to SetMinSum, once Initialized is true no further call to SetMinSum succeeds; the reference C reverts every second call, while the buggy contract M falsely allows a second call to change MinSum because the modifier nonReentrant_ only prevents reentrant calls, not sequential calls after initialization. The rule: after Initialized() is called, any subsequent call to SetMinSum must revert.
change_summary: Assign a different value (e.g., _val + 1) to MinSum, changing the stored sum.
